notes.title: Clunky Hero - Full Version is Out Now!
notes.content:
After about a year in Early Access, where it collected more than 90% positive reviews, [b]Clunky Hero is finally out in its final shape[/b]! Compared to the Early Access, the game has 10 new levels, new bosses and enemies, new weapons, skills and bonus items! It’s overall 30% bigger than the Early Access and improved in many aspects, following Steam’s community suggestions.

So I truly hope you will like it and help it getting the attention it deserves!

I’m self publishing, alone, without a publisher nor resources for a proper marketing, so I truly count on your help to get it out there! If you like the game, a positive review is very welcome, as well as sharing the store page all around social media!

By the way, if you know any influencer or journalist, please put them in contact with me!

In the meantime, enjoy the brand new release trailer:

[previewyoutube=e_lUQchOQNU;full][/previewyoutube]

If you are also a consoles-player, I’m delighted to tell you that[b] Clunky Hero is out also for Nintendo Switch, Xbox and PlayStation![/b] You can find all the links here: [url=https://linktr.ee/clunkyhero]https://linktr.ee/clunkyhero[/url]

And if you want to support my projects, remember that you can also get some merchandising from our online store: [url=https://aotco.e-junkie.com/]https://aotco.e-junkie.com/[/url] (including a retro style Clunky Hero PC Big Box!)
Or with a donation on PayPal: [url=https://paypal.me/NicolaPiovesan]https://paypal.me/NicolaPiovesan[/url]

It has been a long journey, and I truly hope in your help for the release!
Let’s make Clunky Hero a great indie game, all together!

Nicola Piovesan
Clunky Hero developer

notes.title: Clunky Hero Big Update
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We've been working hard on Clunky Hero to improve it and make it bigger.
Here below you can find the list of the additions and improvements, as well as the bugs fixed.
Furthermore, we've designed 2 new areas for a total of 10 new levels, with their own secrets, shops, enemies and bosses! It took us a while, but I'm sure you'll love them! Those, however, are for the Full Release, eta: by the end of the Summer.
Looking forward to your feedback!
To the next update!
Nicola

Enjoy these new screenshots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857910/56f48e87ed47ac77fda107eeacb950158cdfa9f9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40857910/6ed7418b0d7a0e32ebf440f2d45e61c1fdead092.png[/img]


While here the Change Log of our new patch 0.95:


[b]Improvements & Additions[/b]

- The [b]Inventory[/b] now has cells in different colors to highlight the class of an item, to better detect what each item does.

- The game has been translated into two new languages: [b]Norwegian[/b] and [b]Portuguese[/b].

- The [b]Input System[/b] now has a configuration menu to customize every button as the player wishes. [Please note: the buttons icons that appear in-game will stay the default ones. Please note: some voices of the input configuration will stay in English.]

- The [b]UI[/b] has been improved in various aspects, the [b]Quests Interface[/b] is now with a bigger font and it’s scrollable, also to be modular and implement new quests for the full version.

- Some [b]Enemies’ AI[/b] have been improved.

- The [b]Map system[/b] for the whole world has been improved. It is now possible to zoom and scroll it to have a better understanding of the player position and world geography.

- Added an Option to toggle the [b]Camera Shake[/b] during blows and hits.



[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]

- Fixed a bug related with the Side Quests Achievement, not triggering.

- Fixed a bug that was showing a weapon slash right after changing location.

- Fixed a bug with some shops, not selling certain items at the first attempt.

- Polished some bugs related to Enemies Animations.

notes.title: Clunky Hero v0.92 is out there!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
After a bit more than a month from our Early Access release, I'm ready with the first major update that improves lot of things and fixes various bugs! We've followed your feedback and tried to improve Clunky Hero as much as possible with our resources!

Some issues are still there and various things need to be improved. After all it's still an Early Access, but we'll work regularly and update + add levels to Clunky Hero every second month (more or less)!

So please enjoy this update and spread our game out there! Thank you!


[b]Improvements & Additions[/b]

- The [b]input system[/b] has been entirely re-designed to work with any controller out there without troubles.

- [b]Enemies’ AI[/b] has been improved, especially for those foes that were too lazy to attack.

- There’s a [b]Steam Cloud[/b] system now active, to backup your saved files and using them after a format and/or on different machines.

- The [b]Map [/b]system has been highly improved: NPCs, Shops and Tits are now marked on the maps; the Exit Arrows now show what’s the next location; the Map of the Whole World now shows the area names and the numbers of each level. All of this for an easier navigation inside Clunky Hero’s world.

- GamePad [b]button “B”[/b] (or circle for PS controllers, etc.) can now exit the Inventory, Shops or any other sub-menu.

- [b]Quit Game[/b] or going to [b]Main Menu[/b] now ask for a confirmation to avoid accidental progress loss.

- Player is [b]invincible [/b]for a fraction of second after using the [b]Dive skill[/b], to allow a better use of that skill also for attacking enemies.

- [b]Baguette[/b], [b]Pretzel [/b]and [b]Lantern [/b]- that were too overpowered -, have now a shorter duration and a higher price.

- The [b]Localization [/b]has been adjusted in a few points for some languages.

- It is now possible to [b]sell the Treasure Maps[/b].


[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]

- Fixed a bug that was freezing the game if left in Pause for long time.

- Fixed a bug that was destroying a weapon when un-equipping it with full inventory.

- It is now possible to open doors from both sides if player has the right key in inventory.

- Fixed a bug related with the Dive skill, that made the player jumping higher and reaching platforms that wasn’t suppose to.

- Fixed the brambles/spikes that were not damaging when approaching from the side.

- Fixed a bug that made the player invincible when dying and changing area at the same time.

- Fixed a bug that made the player floating near the “wind-trunks” in the Pretty Forest, when the bonus “Eau de la Merde” was active.

- Fixed the area above the Swinagon boss to avoid the player exiting the level wrongly.

- Fixed the Wasteland Map IV that was blank/blind.

- Fixed the way-in/way-out between Foggy Lake III, IV, V.

- Restored the last Bonus Item which is now purchasable from a shop.

- Fixed a bug that allowed the player to shoot the Stinky Dungeon boss even before entering its room.


Please keep reporting bugs and verify that all the improvements and fixes are working properly! Your feedback is truly precious! Thank you!

To the next update.

All the best,
Nicola

notes.title: Clunky Hero is out now!!!
notes.content:
Dear crazy adventurers out there, Clunky Hero - the most bizarre platformer-metroidvania out there - is finally released!!!

Here the last trailer:
[previewyoutube=y_no_4ccRoE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Clunky Hero is coming in a few days!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
The Early Access release of Clunky Hero is approaching...! Just few days left, and next Tuesday, 9th of November, our game will be available!

I've followed the advice of the ones of you that played the demo, and tried to improve the gameplay as much as possible! There are still various things to polish and implement, but I'm sure you'll enjoy Clunky Hero, which will have an estimate gameplay of at least 8 hours!!!

I'm really looking forward for your feedback and suggestions on the Early Access, since your hints will help us improve Clunky Hero, to make it bigger and better, in every aspect.

And remember, we are a small indie team (mostly I developed Clunky Hero alone!), so a word-of-mouth is super important to us! Spread Clunky Hero out there! Share the Steam page within your friends and followers, and let's push for a great release day all together!

Sincerely yours,
Nicola

notes.title: Demo out on Friday 1st October for Steam Next Fest! Full game out 9th November!
notes.content:
Dear fans of the crazy hero with broom and bucket... Great news!!!

First of all... we have a release date for Clunky Hero! And it's 9th November 2021!

We'll first release the game for PC only (Windows, MacOS, Linux) as Early Access. It'll be the full game, with everything there, but we preferred to call it "Early Access" because it won't be the very final version, that we wish to release early 2022 also for consoles (Switch, PS4, XBox). However, it'll be nearly final and we also hope to collect your suggestions to make it even better!

So, just a bit more than a month to wait and you can enjoy Clunky Hero!

In the meantime, you can play the brand new demo at Steam Next Fest 1-7 October! So, starting from Friday you can enjoy the first levels of Rufus' crazy adventure!

Furthermore, Nicola will be doing some live streams to introduce the game and answer all your questions! More info somewhere here on Steam!
